newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Senate panel approves $350 mln prison bond.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Senate panel approves $350 mln prison bond.

text.p: A California state legislative panel on Tuesday approved a $350 million bond measure to fund construction of prisons for young offenders.
The Senate's Public Safety Committee voted unanimously in favor of Senate Bill 808, the Local Juvenile Justice Facilities Bond Act of 1998, at Tuesday's hearing.
The bill will be heard next in the appropriations committee. A hearing date has yet to be set.

If approved by state lawmakers, the $350 million general obligation bond measure would be placed on the November 1998 statewide ballot, according to Democratic Senator Jim Costa, who introduced the bond act.
